info.name: Labscan – Lab, Scan & Appointments
info.description:
Lab, scan center and appointment endpoints of the labscan service.

Set `baseUrl` and `userId` in the collection variables. Every request sends `x-user-id: {{userId}}` (required by create-lab, create-scan-center and the `/user` endpoints; ignored elsewhere).

Create requests store the new id in a collection variable (labId, testCatalogId, labTestId, scanCenterId, serviceCatalogId, scanServiceId), so run each folder top to bottom.

Enums: status = ACTIVE | INACTIVE; fastingRequirement = NOT_REQUIRED | REQUIRED | OPTIONAL. turnaroundTime is an integer.

All routes live under /api/v1/labscan (already in baseUrl). Calling /api/v1/appointments/... without the labscan prefix returns 404.

item.name: Get lab & scan data for user

request.description: Labs and scan centers owned by the user in x-user-id.
Requires x-user-id (stored as labUserId). Only `name` is required.
Labs owned by the user in x-user-id.
Any subset of the lab fields.
Soft delete: sets status to INACTIVE.
`code` (unique) and `name` are required.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "CBC",
  "name": "Complete Blood Count",
  "description": "Measures blood cell counts",
  "category": "Hematology",
  "status": "ACTIVE",
  "fastingRequirement": "NOT_REQUIRED",
  "fastingHours": null,
  "preparationInstructions": "No special preparation needed"
}

item.name: Get lab test catalog by id

request.description: Note the singular `labtestcatalog` in this path.
Adds a catalog test to a lab. `labId` and `testCatalogId` are required; the pair must be unique.
Requires x-user-id (stored as scanCenterUserId). Only `name` is required.
⚠ Currently unreachable on the server: an earlier route with the same method/path pattern handles this request first. `GET /scancenters/:scanCenterId` matches `user` as an id.

item.name: Get scan center metrics by district

request.description: Any subset of the scan center fields.

⚠ Currently unreachable on the server: an earlier route with the same method/path pattern handles this request first. The delete route is registered as PATCH on the same path as update, so this request runs update instead. Send `{"status": "INACTIVE"}` via update to deactivate.
`code` (unique) and `name` are required.

item.name: Get scan service catalog by id

request.description: ⚠ Currently unreachable on the server: an earlier route with the same method/path pattern handles this request first. The delete route is registered as PATCH on the same path as update, so this request runs update instead.
Adds a catalog service to a scan center. `scanCenterId` and `serviceCatalogId` are required; the pair must be unique.

item.name: Appointments
item.description:
Appointment endpoints. Create a lab (or scan) appointment first; it stores appointmentId.

appointmentType = LAB | SCAN; appointmentMode = CENTER | HOME. LAB needs labId + tests (no scanCenterId/services); SCAN needs scanCenterId + services (no labId/tests).
Appointment status = CONFIRMED | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED | CANCELLED | RESCHEDULED. bookingId must be unique. Prices are copied from the lab test / scan service, never sent by the client.

request.description: LAB appointment: labId and at least one test required.
SCAN appointment: scanCenterId and at least one service required. equipmentId is optional.
All appointments for a lab (used by the lab home screen).
All fields optional: appointmentDate, startTime, endTime, address, status, patientNotes.
Optional: equipmentId, status.
